retail.unit: relative conversion difference versus non-AI referrals, percent
retail.scope: Adobe-observed U.S. retail visits. AI referral does not establish autonomous checkout. Comparison group is non-AI traffic, normalized separately in each period.

x402.scope: Provider-tracked x402 activity, historical coverage. September is deliberately excluded: Coinbase Base coverage expanded and was backfilled from September 16, so the publisher withholds September month-over-month comparisons. Transfers do not prove AI identity, delivered services, independent demand or profit.

screening.scope: Independent tracker, six observed facilitators. Pass means no flag under its heuristics, not independently verified commerce. Single-buyer and tiny-repeat rules can flag legitimate activity. USD amounts are the rounded totals displayed on the page.
